identity.name: Great Bridge Capital Company LLC (Guggenheim Treasury Services SPV)

about.registryInfo: Great Bridge Capital Company LLC, a bankruptcy-remote SPV established by Guggenheim Treasury Services, rated Prime-1 by Moody's; backed by maturity-matched US Treasuries with maturities up to 397 days. Ripple invested $10M in the program; >$280M cumulative issuance by June 2025. Ethereum leg is an ERC-1155 (one token-id per CP issue, 2 implied decimals); XRPL issuer rnXNUqF8... issues dated GDCPyyyymmdd currencies with clawback enabled.
